items.reason: Inclusion: 'histologically confirmed pediatric high-grade glioma (pHGG, WHO Grade 3 or 4)'. Grade 4 is explicitly allowed, there is no IDH requirement and glioblastoma is never named, which is the R7 pattern. Against this, 'pediatric high-grade glioma' and 'Diffuse Midline Glioma, H3 K27M-Mutant' are CNS5-style entities that WHO 2021 separates from glioblastoma, and R7 does not address paediatric-type HGG.

note: XL decision needed: does R7 cover paediatric HGG 'WHO grade 3 or 4' (ages 2-25; stdAges CHILD+ADULT, so it passes S4 with mixed_age)? Applying R7 literally includes this atovaquone repurposing trial (a likely 2a candidate). Excluding it needs an R7 carve-out for paediatric-type HGG. Decide consistently with NCT05553041, which has the same wording but is excluded at S6 anyway. any_molecular_selection is true only through the H3K27-altered DMG entry option, which both coders coded as eligibility. Priority-3 control_arm_from_other_arms: two parallel non-control strata, so 'no'.
